title: Assessor record (REQ-ASR-1)
description: A finding, summary or comment written and signed by an assessor. The signature is ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 over the canonical form of the record without its "signature" member: keys sorted, separators "," and ":" with no whitespace, UTF-8, non-ASCII characters unescaped. The signer must be the assessor identity pinned at infrastructure/keys/assessor-identity.json. The provider never edits a record; outputs carry its text verbatim with the signature. A keyless assessor (pinned identity algorithm SIGSTORE_KEYLESS) instead signs one set file holding all its records with Sigstore, and each record carries algorithm SIGSTORE_KEYLESS_SET.

record_id.description: The assessor's identifier for this record; unique.

rule_id.description: Optional. The SDR rule record this attaches to; a rule the SDR does not have fails the build.

value.description: Base64 DER signature (ECDSA_P256_SHA256), or the hex sha256 of the record's canonical form (SIGSTORE_KEYLESS_SET).

signed_set.description: SIGSTORE_KEYLESS_SET only: the name of the Sigstore-signed set file holding this record.
